RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, so an all-female panel selecting another woman provides no credible evidence of sex discrimination. Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and damage your professional reputation.

For a department head position, selection committees frequently prioritize formal management training and broad operational leadership over specialized scientific research qualifications like a PhD. The panel most likely determined that the appointee's management profile was a closer match for the administrative demands of the role.

A two-week delay for written feedback is standard administrative backlog. Follow up politely to request constructive feedback focused on leadership competencies rather than questioning the panel's makeup.
